name: Saddlebrush
description: A quiet isolated town near Annie Flash's ranch.

description_citations.text: "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Annie brings the lockbox to Mr. Towning and they split the cash fifty-fifty.
timeline.quote: Annie watched him divide the cash into two equal parts.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko, disguised as a city man, approaches Annie on her porch and she sees through his illusion with her golden eye.
timeline.quote: My name is Oko—and your ability to see through illusions is exactly why I've been looking for you.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko offers Annie revenge by recruiting her for a heist against Akul, and she refuses.
timeline.quote: I've been putting a team together to steal something important from an outlaw you may know as Akul.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko leaves a saloon matchbook and hints that the Hellspurs could easily find her town.
timeline.quote: If it was this easy for me to find you, imagine how easy it will be if the Hellspurs ever decide to come looking.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie realises her old ghosts have followed her to the only place she cares about.
timeline.quote: her old ghosts had followed her to the only place left in the world that she truly cared about.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Unable to sleep after Oko's threat to her town, Annie digs up her buried thunder rifle.
timeline.quote: pulled the lid back to reveal her thunder rifle.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie leaves Jody Carpenter's bed in Saddlebrush, turning down his offer to stay.
timeline.quote: "Sorry, Jordan. I got my own bed to keep warm."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie glimpses a slithering shadow near the dunes but dismisses it as paranoia.
timeline.quote: Annie catches movement in the distance, a slithering shadow crawling through her periphery.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie returns to her farm and checks in with Fortune, then goes to her sick nephew Tommy.
timeline.quote: Tommy is in bed when she walks in his room, awake and staring out the window.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie gives Tommy blue smoke for his pain, and keeps watch by his bed all night.
timeline.quote: "Here." She holds the bottle under his nose and uncorks it

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie finds a picnic basket on her stoop that appeared overnight without her hearing anyone.
timeline.quote: There's a basket waiting on her stoop that sure as sin wasn't there the night before

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Jody denies leaving the basket and tells Annie the townspeople are worried about her.
timeline.quote: "People 'round here are worried about y'all, out there all alone."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: A giant rattlewurm slithers through Saddlebrush, sending townspeople fleeing, then leaves without hurting anyone.
timeline.quote: an enormous rattlewurm slithers through the streets of Saddlebrush.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The rattlewurm envenoms Mira, and Annie gives her blue smoke.
timeline.quote: Annie hardly knows what she's doing before she's doing it

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie volunteers to kill the rattlewurm and Bo offers to come along; she sets out at dawn the next day.
timeline.quote: "I'll kill the thing."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie tells Tommy she is leaving to hunt the rattlewurm, and he refuses medicine, saying he is tired all the time.
timeline.quote: "Tired … all the time."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Tommy appears with a walking stick and tells Bo to bring his aunt back.
timeline.quote: "You come back with my aunt. Or you don't come back. You hear me?"

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie uses her enhanced vision to find the rattlewurm's lair and sees a baby rattlewurm joining it.
timeline.quote: another rattlewurm emerges. This one is considerably smaller.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie decides not to slaughter the rattlewurms, and instead corrals them deeper into the dunes, which the townsfolk accept.
timeline.quote: for corralling them deeper into the dunes where prey was more plentiful and people scarcer

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Tommy tells Annie he is leaving for home and real medicine, with arrangements made through Jody.
timeline.quote: "Back to our people."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Tommy embraces Annie, calling her Haseya, and tells her he loves her before leaving.
timeline.quote: I couldn't hate you. I love you.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie concludes that she can build a community but will still be alone with her ghosts at night.
timeline.quote: it's always gonna be Annie Flash and her ghosts.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko waits on Annie's porch to recruit her for a heist against Akul; she refuses at first.
timeline.quote: she found that Oko was waiting for her on her front porch

citation.work: Annie Flash
citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
